metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds seventeen shillings, a ring of green oak, and the boat.

yesterday: Monday and Wednesday, Two Gentlemen, and you play. Tuesday and Friday, Love's Labour's Lost, and you play, with rehearsal Tuesday at nine. Saturday, Errors, and you play.
Green oak. It will twist. It is bigger than his. A goldsmith, and letters written against him. You stayed in the boat.
Six Spanish galleys, or four. Tomorrow is church, and the house.
